segments.name: Quantum computing
segments.description: Develops photonic quantum computers and the PennyLane software platform, offering cloud-based quantum computing access and professional services.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in a single operating and reportable segment and manages segment performance and resource allocation based upon consolidated net loss.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for cloud-based access to the company's quantum computing systems, related professional services, and software frameworks.
revenueModel.evidence: Our business model focuses on providing customers with access to our quantum computing systems through cloud-based services, enabling quantum-computing-as-a-service ("QCaaS"), as well as offering related professional services to help organizations explore and implement quantum solutions.
